title: Name the single observed check's source field as check.source_basis, and qualify edge-whitespace refusals, in host source-text refusals
outcome: Name the single observed check's source field as check.source_basis, and qualify edge-whitespace refusals, in host source-text refusals
acceptance: An execution_observe request of kind observed_check whose check source holds a refused character is refused as execution_observation_invalid naming check.source_basis.workspace_id or check.source_basis.source_revision (the request's actual path), while an unadmitted turn's checks keep observed_checks[i].source_basis.*; the refusals test asserts both paths

The behavioral-control-plane brief says that a refused character that is also whitespace at a field's start or end keeps the existing trim refusal code, or the character check runs first so every refused character gets the endpoint's text refusal; a test covers the chosen behaviour

completion.summary: execution_observe names a single observed check's refused source text check.source_basis.* (an unadmitted turn's checks keep observed_checks[i].source_basis.*), still as execution_observation_invalid; the control-plane brief documents that a refused whitespace control at a field's edge keeps the trimmed-field refusal (invalid_control_session at turn_checkpoint), with a test. Store judgment: none; readiness ready on all 4 stores.
